_note: Rules checked against the cited sources on 2026-10-18. 'verified' means the obligation, legal flag, penalty note and source_url were checked. 'timing_basis' says whether the due date comes from the source ('source') or is this service's recommendation within what the source allows ('recommendation'). Re-check before any real use: rules and fines change.
_condition_format: applies_if is a list of conditions that must all hold. An empty list means always. {"fact": name, "equals": value}, {"fact": name, "in": [values]} or {"fact": name, "not_in": [values]}. A missing fact makes the rule needs_review rather than applies. old_country, new_country and same_council (both postcodes in one council) come from council_lookup.
_timing_format: anchor is completion or exchange. offset_days is signed (negative = before). working_days true counts Mon-Fri excluding bank holidays. window is before, on, on_or_after or after.
_ids_note: Task IDs follow the order of this list (rule 1 is T-01), so add new rules at the end and never reorder or delete one: delete by making its applies_if impossible instead.

rules.penalty_note: You can be fined up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA when your address changes. Changing the address is free.
rules.verify_hint: gov.uk: 'You must update your provisional or full driving licence when you move.' You can keep driving while you wait for the new licence.

rules.penalty_note: You can be fined up to £1,000 if you do not tell DVLA when your address changes. Usually free. Only the registered keeper can do it.
rules.verify_hint: Needs the registration number and the log book reference. Check whether the vehicle needs taxing in the next 4 weeks first.

rules.penalty_note: Councils can charge a £70 penalty if you fail, without reasonable excuse, to notify them of a change such as moving (Local Government Finance Act 1992, Schedule 3). You pay up to the date your sale completes.
rules.verify_hint: Each council sets its own notice window (often 2 to 4 weeks before the move). Use the old council's own move-out form. Leeds: https://www.leeds.gov.uk/council-tax/report-a-change/register-for-council-tax-or-change-your-address

rules.penalty_note: Councils can charge a £70 penalty if you fail, without reasonable excuse, to notify them of a change such as moving in (Local Government Finance Act 1992, Schedule 3). You are charged from the day you become liable.
rules.verify_hint: Use the new council's own form. North Yorkshire: https://www.northyorks.gov.uk/council-tax/tell-us-about-council-tax-change. In Scotland this bill also collects water and sewerage charges.

rules.penalty_note: You need to register again at a new address. If you are asked to register and do not, you could be fined up to £1,000.
rules.verify_hint: Fine wording: https://www.gov.uk/electoral-register. Each adult registers separately; a National Insurance number is asked for.

rules.penalty_note: None, but without notice you may be billed for energy used after you leave. Give a forwarding address for the final bill.
rules.verify_hint: Citizens Advice: give at least 48 hours' notice. Ofgem also covers moving home: https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/information-consumers/energy-advice-households/get-energy-if-you-are-moving-home-or-business-premises

rules.penalty_note: None, but without readings the final bill is estimated. Keep a note of readings and dates in case of a dispute.
rules.verify_hint: Citizens Advice: read your meters on the day you move out.

rules.penalty_note: None, but without enough notice you could be charged for water used after you move out.
rules.verify_hint: Citizens Advice (England): if metered, give at least 5 working days' notice for a final reading. Unmetered has no fixed period. Scotland and Northern Ireland have no separate household water account to close.

rules.org: Water and sewerage (collected with council tax)
rules.penalty_note: No separate action for unmetered homes: Scottish councils collect water and sewerage charges with council tax. Metered homes are billed by Scottish Water directly.
rules.verify_hint: Also https://www.mygov.scot/water-sewerage-services

rules.penalty_note: Early termination charges may apply if you leave mid-contract, for example when the new address is not served. Ask your provider for the figure in writing.
rules.verify_hint: No official lead time: 3 weeks is a practical allowance for an engineer visit. Check the provider's home-move terms.

rules.penalty_note: A licence covers an address and does not move automatically. You can update it up to three months before you move.
rules.verify_hint: Sign in with the licence number, surname and postcode on the licence.

rules.penalty_note: None. Optional paid service. With less than 5 working days' notice some post may still go to the old address.
rules.verify_hint: Royal Mail needs at least 5 working days and recommends applying about 3 weeks before the move. Check current prices.

rules.penalty_note: None.
rules.verify_hint: Internal: the bank updates the address directly.

rules.penalty_note: Not required by law, but a mortgage lender usually requires buildings cover, and you are responsible for the property from exchange.
rules.verify_hint: MoneyHelper: https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/blog/insurance/what-insurance-do-I-need-when-buying-a-house. Confirm the start date with the lender or conveyancer.

rules.penalty_note: Not a legal requirement in itself, but an address change is usually material to the policy: not telling the insurer can lead to a refused claim or cancelled cover, and driving uninsured is an offence.
rules.verify_hint: Materiality of an address change: Financial Ombudsman decisions. Check the policy's 'changes you must tell us about' terms.

rules.penalty_note: None. A surgery may refuse registration if you live outside its area. No ID, proof of address or NHS number is needed to register.
rules.verify_hint: Most people register with a surgery near where they live.

rules.penalty_note: Keepers are responsible for keeping microchip details up to date, for example after moving. Fines of up to £500 apply if a dog or cat is not microchipped or not registered on an approved database.
rules.verify_hint: Contact the database the chip is registered on (a fee may apply). Find it from the chip number at check-a-chip.co.uk.

rules.penalty_note: None, but the nursery's contract notice period applies.
rules.verify_hint: No official rule: the notice period is in the nursery contract (4 weeks is a common default). For a new place, see the new council's admissions pages.

rules.penalty_note: None, but you will be billed as the new occupier. Water and sewerage may come from two different companies.
rules.verify_hint: Find the company for the new postcode with Water UK's checker (linked from CCW), or from the seller's last bill.

rules.org: Domestic rates: Land & Property Services (Northern Ireland)
rules.penalty_note: Northern Ireland has domestic rates, not council tax. Tell LPS immediately when you move, or you may get a backdated rate bill for after you left.
rules.verify_hint: Report it with the online form at https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/services/create-or-update-your-rate-account using the occupancy, account or ratepayer ID from the rate bill.

rules.org: Domestic rates: Land & Property Services (Northern Ireland)
rules.penalty_note: When you buy a home in Northern Ireland you must tell LPS immediately and open a domestic rate account.
rules.verify_hint: Online form: https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/services/create-or-update-your-rate-account

rules.org: Northern Ireland driving licence: contact DVLA
rules.penalty_note: DVA cannot register a new address outside Northern Ireland on an NI licence. Contact the licensing authority where you now live (DVLA) about exchanging it.
rules.verify_hint: nidirect does not state the exchange steps or a fine for this case: confirm with DVLA before relying on it.

rules.penalty_note: None, but cards, statements and security checks use the address on file; an out-of-date address can block payments or leave post at the old home.
rules.verify_hint: Most banks let you change your address in their app or online banking. Placeholder source: no official rule.

rules.org: Council tax: {new_council} (moving within the council area)
rules.penalty_note: Councils can charge a £70 penalty if you fail, without reasonable excuse, to notify them of a change such as moving (Local Government Finance Act 1992, Schedule 3). Moving within one council area is one change of address: the bill moves to the new home from the day you become liable there.
rules.verify_hint: Tell the council once, using its change-of-address or moving-within-the-area form, giving both addresses and the date. In Scotland this bill also collects water and sewerage charges.

rules.penalty_note: None, but statements, cards and security checks use the address on file. If the old home is being sold, the conveyancer usually repays its mortgage at completion; tell the lender where to send any final statement.
rules.verify_hint: No official rule: lenders' terms ask customers to keep their address up to date. One task per mortgage, credit card or loan lender found in the customer's payments.
